title: Account History Rule: Frequency Share of Late-Delivery Refunds on a Delivery & Pickup Services Plan
content:
The frequency share of a late-delivery refund on a Delivery & Pickup Services plan depends on the late-delivery refunds already booked on the plan in the 3 months up to today. The late-delivery refund is multiplied by the frequency share, taken as a percentage, acting on the refund as worked out up to that point; no rounding takes place at this step.

## Rule

| Late-delivery refunds already booked on the plan in the 3 months up to today | Frequency share |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 50 percent |
| at least the plan's most late refunds per cycle, but fewer than 6 | 80 percent |
| fewer than the plan's most late refunds per cycle | 100 percent |

The middle threshold is the plan's own figure for the most late refunds per billing cycle (per calendar month on a plan without a subscription):

| Plan | Most late refunds per cycle or month | 100 percent band | 80 percent band | 50 percent band |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | 2 | 0 or 1 | 2 to 5 | 6 or more |
| Kestrel Mail Delivery | 0 | — | 0 to 5 | 6 or more |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | 4 | 0 to 3 | 4 or 5 | 6 or more |
| Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | 4 | 0 to 3 | 4 or 5 | 6 or more |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | 4 | 0 to 3 | 4 or 5 | 6 or more |
| Kestrel Specialty Courier Service | 2 | 0 or 1 | 2 to 5 | 6 or more |

Only refunds booked for late delivery count; refunds of fees on cancelled or lost orders do not.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

On Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly with 4 late-delivery refunds booked in the last 3 months, a refund worked out so far at 6.99 is multiplied by 80 percent: 5.592.
